invariants.KVCache_V2_backend: C++ default, explicitly enabled V2, validated binding identity
invariants.warmup: 2 separate streaming requests before each fresh smoke/full phase; excluded from counters and client measurement

metric_definitions.AL: 1 + sum(generation accepted per-position counter deltas) / generation drafted position-zero delta. _accumulate_spec_dec_stats resets the per-step verified count and increments position zero exactly once for every positive-draft verification. TP1, one frontend, only generation worker, no rank summation.
metric_definitions.TPOT: Pinned metrics_table.TpotTrigger: (complete timestamp - first content-chunk timestamp) / Qwen tokenization of concatenated text after first content chunk; skip zero-denominator requests.
metric_definitions.E2E: Pinned report.e2e_avg_interactivity: client output tokens / sum request latency seconds, no failures permitted.
metric_definitions.TPS_GPU: Pinned output_sequence_lengths.total / (duration_ns/1e9) / 2. Native concurrency measurement tracking window, not container wall-clock.
metric_definitions.OSL: Pinned client Qwen retokenization of complete output text (special tokens omitted by serving); may differ from internal generated-token count.
metric_definitions.warmup: Separate two-request streaming Endpoints invocation completes before before-counters snapshot. Client internal warmup disabled. Fresh workers before smoke and full.
metric_definitions.server_settings: Recovered branch a3246d263a6ef571100683b15f004a714db885ad Qwen common_options; explicit KV V2 and explicit default stream_interval=1; client concurrency=4, server max_batch_size=1.
metric_definitions.AL_terminal_semantics: Accepted draft counters are verification decisions (num_new_tokens - 1), including terminal-step verified tokens even if output is truncated at EOS/length; they are not reconstructed from output length.

limitations: Whole-revision comparison; revisions contain changes beyond the unified draft KV-cache fix. One full measured trial per revision; no run-to-run uncertainty estimate.

Prompt corpus recovered from fork revision a3246d263a6ef571100683b15f004a714db885ad, results/dspark-agg-reference-11/prompts.jsonl. The deleted reference-1 file was unavailable; equality to that file cannot be proved. All three runs used the same recovered bytes and issue order.

Current used the existing compatible native binaries (checkpointed and checksum-recorded). Main and ec4ef266 required native rebuilds for KV-cache compatibility, using the same cached environment/build configuration. No Python dependencies were changed. Existing binaries do not provide a verified build-source SHA.
Main auto-calculated max_gpu_total_bytes is 101400705638 versus 101398189056 for current/ec4ef266; the configured free_gpu_memory_fraction is 0.6 in every run.

ec4ef266 lacks newer optional fields swa_endpoint_rewind_tokens=0, per_request_spec_decode_stats=False, iter_perf_stats_interval=1. Qwen sliding-window attention is disabled, per-request stats are disabled, and iteration interval remains every iteration. Explicit server recipes are identical.

Pinned client OSL is Qwen retokenization of streamed text, excluding special tokens. TPOT uses tokens in concatenated text after the first content chunk, as implemented by client 89904fb; it is not (E2E-TTFT)/(OSL-1).

AL uses real generation verification decisions, including terminal-step acceptance before output truncation. Position-zero drafted counter is validated as one count per verification step; no division by fixed draft length, prefill speculation, or rank duplication.
Server batch size 1 and client concurrency 4 are preserved. This is a local Qwen comparison, not tuned peak throughput, a Kimi agentic reproduction, or an MLPerf submission.

An earlier setup attempt had two rejected warmup requests because the pinned client defaulted min_new_tokens to 1. All three reported runs use matched min_new_tokens=0; those failed warmup requests are preserved separately and excluded.
